items.title: Kenyan cult leader found guilty over 190 children starved to death in the hope of ‘meeting Jesus’
items.brief: The leader of a Kenyan Christian cult has been found guilty of the murder of 190 children.

items.title: Victoria’s Secret reboots its fantasy with a $50M diamond bra
items.brief: On Sunday night, just when you thought the megawatt spectacle that is the Victoria’s Secret runway show couldn’t get any glitzier, out struts Kylie Jenner in a $50 million diamond brasserie.

items.title: Expedition to a remote Pacific island fails to find fresh clues in hunt for Amelia Earhart’s plane
items.brief: A recent expedition to a remote South Pacific island to search for wreckage from Amelia Earhart’s lost plane has come up empty.

items.title: US citizen injured during California ICE incident, officials say
items.brief: A former Long Beach city employee was injured during an incident involving Immigration and Customs Enforcement on Saturday, according to federal and local officials.

items.title: Christiane Amanpour announces she will leave CNN next June
items.brief: CNN legend Christiane Amanpour, the network’s chief international anchor, said Monday that she will sign off from CNN next June.

items.title: Elon Musk says he will give a SpaceX share to ‘every kid in America’
items.brief: Elon Musk has said he will give every child in America a stake in SpaceX, his $2 trillion aerospace and artificial intelligence company, as tech firms face intensifying scrutiny over their impact on society.
